title: A finitely presented ring map with the square-zero lifting property is smooth
statement: Let $\varphi:R\to S$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings such that $S$ is a finitely presented $R$-algebra and $\varphi$ is formally smooth in the sense of Stacks Algebra, Definition 00TI: for every commutative ring $D$ with a ring map $R\to D$, every ideal $N\subseteq D$ with $N^2=0$, with quotient map $q:D\to D/N$, and every homomorphism of $R$-algebras $g:S\to D/N$, there is a homomorphism of $R$-algebras $f:S\to D$ with $q\circ f=g$. Then $\varphi$ is a smooth ring map [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map]: $H_1(L_{S/R})=0$ and $\Omega_{S/R}$ [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials] is a finite projective $S$-module.
